triples.head_surface: low level conditions of fuel oil settling and service tanks
triples.head_canonical_zh: 燃油沉淀柜和服务柜低液位
triples.tail_surface: alarmed at the centralized control station
triples.evidence_text: low level conditions of fuel oil settling and service tanks are to be alarmed at the centralized control station
Where tanks are automatically filled, high level alarms are also to be provided

triples.head_surface: catastrophic contamination (e.g. by water ingress) of the fuel service tank
triples.head_canonical_zh: 燃油服务柜严重污染（如进水）
triples.tail_surface: have fuel immediately ready for use
triples.evidence_text: This requirement was derived from the need to have fuel immediately ready for use in the event of catastrophic contamination (e.g. by water ingress) of the fuel service tank in use

triples.head_surface: spillages or leakages on heated surfaces
triples.head_canonical_zh: 热表面上的溢油或泄漏
triples.tail_surface: not to be located over boilers
triples.evidence_text: they are not to be located over boilers

triples.head_surface: leakage points such as manholes, drain valves, gauge glasses
triples.head_canonical_zh: 泄漏点（如人孔、排放阀、液位计）
triples.tail_surface: oil tight spill tray of ample size
triples.evidence_text: placed in an oil tight spill tray of ample size (e.g., large enough to cover leakage points such as manholes, drain valves, gauge glasses, etc.)
